WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Estimation of Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Estimation of Materials.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Estimation of Materials.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Estimation of Materials.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Estimation of Materials.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. CPU

4. When learning Blending wood with other materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Blending wood with other materials.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending wood with other materials.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Blending wood with other materials.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Blending wood with other materials.

5. When learning Occupational Information, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Occupational Information.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Occupational Information.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Occupational Information.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Occupational Information.

6. When learning Furniture Making, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Furniture Making.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Furniture Making.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Furniture Making.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Furniture Making.

7. When learning Upholstery, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Upholstery.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Upholstery.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Upholstery.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Upholstery.

8. When learning Emergency Management, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Emergency Management.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emergency Management.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emergency Management.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emergency Management.

9. When learning Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fittings.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fittings.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Fittings.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fittings.

10. When learning Design in Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Design in Woodwork.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Design in Woodwork.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Design in Woodwork.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Design in Woodwork.

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Ignore burnt cables

12. When learning Entrepreneurship in Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship in Woodwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Blending wood with other materials and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Furniture Making and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Framed Wooden Doors and Windows and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
